_comment: LOD phase 3 tier-transition demo: two cavalry blocks spawn with 620 wu between their edges (the tier pass measures the gap between the blocks' edges, not their centres; the 280 wu of block half-width puts the centres 900 apart) -- beyond DEMOTE_RANGE (600) -- so Battle's tier pass collapses BOTH to the aggregate far tier on the first tick (no per-soldier state; the marks you see are drawn on the formation grid itself). The player selects the left block and orders it toward the enemy while the enemy AI marches in from the right; when the edge gap closes inside PROMOTE_RANGE (400, around tick 205 with this seed) both formations PROMOTE the same tick -- per-soldier bodies reconstruct from the deterministic seeded hash (a light scatter ruffle that immediately eases back onto the slots). The 'state' ticks dump machine-readable snapshots for the determinism check: run the dump twice from this same seed and the post-promotion layouts match exactly.
